# Brauns Law

> > Georgia-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident claims, catastrophic injuries, and insurance disputes with free consultations and contingency fee representation.

Brauns Law is a personal injury law firm founded by David Brauns, serving the Duluth and Gwinnett County areas of Georgia. The firm handles a wide range of accident and injury cases including motor vehicle collisions, workers' compensation, premises liability, and catastrophic injuries.
